tools.purpose: Author editable geometry, transforms, UVs, vertex data, LODs, collision candidates, sockets, hierarchy, and exchange files.
tools.boundary: DCC state does not prove target-runtime behavior or game readiness.

tools.purpose: Measure and localize geometry, normal, tangent, UV, texel, cage, padding, bake, and topology defects.
tools.boundary: Structural cleanliness does not prove art quality or runtime fitness.

tools.purpose: Author and export declared PBR material inputs and renderer-specific variants with color-space and channel control.
tools.boundary: A material preview does not prove target-shader equivalence.

tools.purpose: Check the exact exchange candidate against the declared format and extension contract.
Import or re-import the exact candidate and inspect target-side meshes, materials, textures, LODs, collision, sockets, bounds, and warnings.
tools.boundary: Clean import is not final integration, performance, gameplay, art, or rights acceptance.

tools.purpose: Inspect exact rendered or runtime frames, turntables, debug views, LOD transitions, lighting conditions, and camera distances.
accepted_evidence: camera, lighting, material, mip, and LOD state
tools.boundary: Only visible sampled state is observed; absence of evidence outside it is not a pass.

tools.purpose: Record target-context geometry, material, texture, memory, draw, skinning, streaming, or frame-cost evidence supplied under technical ownership.
tools.boundary: The specialist may consume and respond to measurements but does not self-certify global performance budgets.

tools.purpose: Track origin, authorship, generation, consent, license, attribution, modifications, hashes, and downstream restrictions.
tools.boundary: Recorded terms are evidence for IP review, not automatic legal clearance.
